title: Uruguayan Beef Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful Uruguayan-inspired beef casserole, made with gluten-free ingredients.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the Uruguayan seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the gluten-free tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the meat mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Roll out the gluten-free casserole crust to fit the top of the baking dish.
Place the crust on top of the meat mixture and crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
